name: Brian Fitzpatrick
page_title: Brian Fitzpatrick's Issue Positions (Political Courage Test)
on_the_ballot: Running, Republican for U.S. House (PA) - District 1

positions.question: Do you generally support pro-choice or pro-life legislation?

evidence.text: Rated 17% by Planned Parenthood Action Fund
Rated 83% by National Right to Life Committee
Voted in favor H.R. 8297 "Ensuring Access to Abortion Act of 2022"
Voted in favor of H.R. 4712 "Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act"
Rated 77% by Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America
Voted against HR 8296 "Women's Health Protection Act of 2022"

"In our community, and across America, the vast and overwhelming majority do not support rigid, single-party, all-or-nothing solutions. The vast and overwhelming majority do not support complete legislative bans, nor do they support a legislative-absent Wild West "anything-goes" scenario that would allow for the atrocities committed by Kermit Gosnell in Philadelphia. As our community, and our nation, do not support all-or-nothing approaches, nor should any representative who seeks to reflect the will of the people. The bipartisan, bicameral approach reflected in H.R. 36 is a good starting point for state legislatures across America to begin building bipartisan bridges and consensus. At the core of our democracy must always be the goal of building bridges, not driving wedges. This issue, as sensitive as it is, must be approached in this same manner. With empathy, with understanding, and with compassion. I urge all state legislatures, including in my own state of Pennsylvania, to follow this lead. Support two-party solutions. Reject single-party solutions. Build bridges, don’t drive wedges."

positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: "85 years ago today, the #SocialSecurity Act became law. This incredibly important program has helped our senior citizens for decades, and allowed them to retire in peace. I will continue my fight to protect and strengthen this program for our community's seniors."
"I will always stand to protect the benefits our seniors are owed. Make no mistake, it’s your money, and I am absolutely committed to protecting the benefits you earned."

"Like most of you, my parents worked a lifetime to earn their Medicare and Social Security. Some politicians seek to cut these programs. I will fight to protect and strengthen these programs for all of our seniors."
"Proud to join the @narfehq to stand with them to protect Medicare, Medicaid, and Social Security."

positions.question: Do you support the federal government increasing funding for affordable housing programs?

evidence.text: "Habitat for Humanity of Bucks County has blessed our community for decades and have been tireless advocates for affordable housing in our community."

"Habitat for Humanity partners with people in local communities all over the world to help build homes. We chatted about the lack of affordable housing, specifically in Bucks County, and how Congress can help change this through legislation that would lower the barriers to homeownership and encourage private investment to build homes in distressed communities. Thank you for all that you do in Bucks County and around the Keystone state."
"It is through this design of co-locating affordable housing, services, and communal space, Edison 64 Veterans will have the best opportunity to create successful, independent lives."
Voted in favor of HR 5735 "THRIVE Act"

positions.question: Do you support the federal government taking action, beyond those of the Federal Reserve, to alleviate inflation?

evidence.text: "I introduced the bipartisan Member Business Loan Expansion Act with @RepGonzalez, which would update the Credit Union Member Business Loan authority under current federal law to keep pace with inflation and increase access to loans for small businesses."

"Prices continue to rise for American families. Consumer prices jumped 5.4% year over year. Out of control inflation is a tax on families and eats into hard-earned paychecks. It’s time for DC to look out for Main Street and take this situation seriously."
Voted against H.R. 5376 "Build Back Better Act (Inflation Reduction Act of 2022)"
Voted against H.R. 7688 "Consumer Fuel Price Gouging Prevention Act"

positions.question: Do you support the forgiveness of federal student loan debt?

evidence.text: "For too many, student loan debt is a crippling burden that impacts their involvement in our economy and achieving personal goals. My bill with @RepGaramendi is a step toward addressing this crisis."

"By allowing this year’s graduates to defer their student loan payments for up to three years, my legislation with @RepJoshHarder will allow them to enter the job market and give them one less thing to worry about."

"For too many, student loan debt is a crippling burden that impacts their involvement in our economy and achieving personal goals like owning a home, starting a family and supporting their community. I have introduced bipartisan legislation to address this crisis. The Student Loan Refinancing and Recalculation Act would allow students to refinance their student loan interest rates, lower future student loan interest rates, eliminate origination fees on student loans, delay student loan interest rate accrual for low-income and middle-class borrowers while they are pursuing their education, and allow for borrowers in medical or dental residencies to defer payments until the completion of their program."
Voted against H.R. 2547 "Comprehensive Debt Collection Improvement Act"

positions.question: Should the government be able to regulate the cost of prescription drugs?

evidence.text: "In Congress, I’m fighting for a health care system that works for everyone and lowers the cost of prescription drugs."

"In Congress, I’m fighting for a health care system that works for everyone, increases access and competition, and lowers the cost of prescription drugs. I Voted in favor of legislation to establish a fair price negotiation program, protect the Medicare program from excessive price increase and establish an out-of-pocket maximum for Medicare part D enrollees."

"We also need to lower the cost of prescription drugs, and I have introduced the bipartisan Increasing Access to Biosimilars Act to help reduce the cost of prescription drugs by encouraging competition and increasing access to biosimilars."
Voted in favor of the H.R. 3 "Lower Drug Costs Now Act of 2019"

positions.question: Do you support increasing security along the southern US border?

evidence.text: "I Voted in favor of legislation which would keep families together, provide $25 billion in border security funding, and ensure law enforcement has the tools it needs to secure our border and process those arriving."

"I will always support our Customs and Border Protection officers. These brave men and women spend every day on the front lines, defending our borders from those who wish us harm. Congress must fully fund investments in technology, including drones and aerial surveillance, infrared technology, heat sensors, motion detectors, and an array of 21st century high-tech options that serve as force-multipliers along the border. And this includes physical barriers where law enforcement deem them necessary."

"I’ve seen firsthand the threats our nation faces from a porous border and a broken immigration system: First as an FBI Agent working border security, and later as a member of Congress’ Homeland Security Committee. Congress must act now to secure our borders, respect the rule of law, and show compassion for those legitimately fleeing gang violence and drug cartels."
Voted in favor of H.R. 6136 "Border Security and Immigration Reform Act of 2018"

"This year for their annual Spring Breakfast with the Bucks County School Administrators Association, I teamed up with the IU to have a discussion focused on immigrant pathways for Ukrainian refugees to inform our school leadership of the immigration programs available for our Ukrainian students."
"We must find the compromise that both secures our borders and protects our Dreamers."
